scene sky
Lately, I’ve been feeling like pretty much the whole world is against me. Which is kind of par for the course after the world finds out you’re dating a celebrity, I guess.
And while this is not the life I would have chosen for myself, I do think it’s funny that I didn’t even need to work for it the way Niki did and I’m sure that probably bothers her.

But I’m also pretty sure she would say something about me not being an actual celebrity since I’m just stitched to her coattails or something like that but, in a sense, she’s stitched to mine as well.
So the two of us at this point are essentially just a toxic and immobile quilt. And that sucks. But there are bright sides, surely. Because there’s no way everyone keeps up with pop culture, right?
For example — I’m calling Miku right now since she seems mildly detached from all of that stuff when compared to everyone else.
: Yo! How’s my favorite idol-bangin’ teacher?
But apparently not detached enough. So there goes whatever I was about to say, I guess.
: I’m afraid to leave my house. People keep taking pictures of me.
: Your pants zipped up? No big floppy wiener hangin’ out and enticin’ all the soccer moms?
: Yes, Miku. My pants are zipped up.
: Yeah, probably just the idol thing then.
: You don’t say.
: The heck you callin’ me for? Shouldn’t you be stickin’ it in Noriko’s sister’s mouth or somethin’? Ain’t no way I can compare to her.
: You’re actually pretty good at blowjobs, Miku. It’s a quality I didn’t expect, but I very much appreciate.
: Thanks! Gotta prove my worth somehow since my vagina is broken.
: I think it’s fixed by now, Miku. And I also think that you should stop whatever you’re doing to come hang out with me.
: What? Uhh...but didn’t you just say all that stuff about people takin’ pictures of you?
: Cause I ain’t exactly on the best terms with Maki right now and the last thing I need is proof that you’re the one porkin’ or...at least trying to pork me.
: I’m not suggesting we go on some date outdoors or something. Just come over and hang out with me.
: I’d like the company of someone less...pink this time. Someone more uninformed and detached from the expectations of society.
: Society don’t care about how pink somebody is, Sensei. It’s all about just doin’ what everybody else is doin’ around here. And not everybody’s bagged Niki Nakayama.
: ’Sides, your place ain’t exactly safe either. Like, how do I know Ami won’t snap a picture of me and use it for some sort of blackmail thingy? Or how do we know Niki won’t find you bangin’ me next?
: Whole situation’s too hot, and not in the good way. So we should probably just wait until things start coolin’ down to actually hang out again.
: Unless of course you’ve got some sort of top-secret rendezvous point or somethin’ where we could meet up away from the pryin’ eyes of the paparazzi.
: Yeah, about that. I do.
: You know, I should probably be surprised, but I really ain’t. You’re a shady friggin’ guy, Sensei.
: Hey, you’re the one coming to meet up with me at a discreet location. That makes you just as bad as me.
: I don’t think it does, but sign me up! And no cameras, got it? Last thing I need right now is more heat. It’s gettin’ exhaustin’ havin’ to deal with the new Maki.
: New Maki?
: I’ll tell ya more about it when I get to your sex dungeon! Send me the address and I’ll drop by after school.
: Oh, right. You’re in school.
: Yeah. You wanna say hi to Futaba? She’s been with me in the library this whole time.
: She’s been listening?
: Hi, Sensei...And don’t worry, I won’t say anything.
: Futaba and I were just bondin’ over bein’ sexually active before you called. See what I said there? Futaba and I. We’re studying too.
: That...is the main reason we are in the library. We did not come here to talk about sex.
: Potato, tomato. Anyway, I’m startin’ to get stared at, so I’ll see ya later! Bye, Sensei! I mean...boyfriend from another school!
: Bring Futaba as well and I can educate the two of you about threesomes.
: Pass! The more wiener I get for myself, the better. Bye!
: But-
scene black
Damn it.
How did that not work?
scene mikusecretapt1
Miku arrives at my under-utilized secret apartment about an hour after school ends and it immediately dawns on me that I now have a use for this place again since my regular house is bugged.
And while I’m pretty sure I managed to find most of Ami’s recording devices, I imagine there are more I just haven’t found yet.
Which means I must now put all of my faith in Touka and hope that she hasn’t actually bugged this place too.
: Hey! Sorry for not bringin’ Futaba. But if it makes ya feel any better, we ain’t really sure how a threesome’d work in the first place since we both like boys.
: Plus, havin’ those bazongas in my face’d probably make me freak out and bite your wiener off outta jealousy or somethin’.
: If I wanted Ami here, I would have invited Ami.
scene mikusecretapt2
: Yeah, I guess if we’re really gonna do this with three people, havin’ somebody like her would be a lot better for my self-confidence.
: That’s not what- hah. Okay. Hi. Welcome to my secret apartment.
: How the heck do you even afford this place? You don’t have a job.
: Touka gave it to me. And try to keep your voice down since Chika and Tsukasa also live here.
: Ain’t Tsukasa that little girl who hijacked the class for some bogus national holiday a while back? You porkin’ her too?
: No, Miku. I am not having sex with Touka’s little sister.
: Hey, I never know with you. What’s the plan, though? I ain’t ever been a call-girl before. You payin’ me for this?
: No, I just wanted to see you. I missed you.
scene mikusecretapt3
: Y...You...huh?!
scene mikusecretapt4
: D...Don’t just say stuff like that outta the blue! I’m still a girl, ya know! Ya gotta hit me with a little emotional foreplay before you bust a load like that all over my face!
: I also don’t think I’ve mentioned that I like your new haircut yet either. You look really cute.
scene mikusecretapt5
: That...I...uhh...
: Thank you...
: I wanted to keep growin’ it out since I heard ya like it that way, but...the thing happened again and Makoto had to...clean stuff up.
: Is everything okay? Did something happen?
: Not that I can remember...Just kinda happened one night. Whole thing still feels like a blur. So weird.
scene mikusecretapt6
: You really like it? You ain’t just sayin’ that to make me feel better?
: Yes. It looks very soft and makes me want to reach forward and mess it up so you can look even more embarrassed.
scene mikusecretapt7
: I...I ain’t embarrassed! Just a little surprised and flattered and horny! What do you have in the fridge?!
: Nice segue.
scene mikusecretapt8
: Fine! You leave me no choice but to go check myself!
: Miku-
scene mikusecretapt9
: No ifs, ands, or asses! We both know you’re a guy who strictly adheres to gender norms, which means I’m expected to make ya dinner if you didn’t call me over here to put it in my mouth!
: Miku Maruyama can be a trad-wife too! You just watch, buddy!
: Miku, put the cooking equipment down. I don’t want this building going up in flames when children live here.
scene mikusecretapt10
: Oh? You doubtin’ my abilities to cook, Sensei?
: Yes. As a matter of fact, I am. Lets just order a pizza if you’re hungry.
: And if the pizza delivery girl is a rabid Niki fan who finds out about your secret apartment, then what? You willin’ to have that secret blown just cause you don’t believe in me?
: It’s not that I don’t believe in you. I just think you’re going to do a terrible job that could result in the deaths of many.
scene mikusecretapt11
: That sounds a lot like you not believin’ in me, Sensei.
: Damn. I was hoping your listening comprehension hadn’t improved much either. You got me, though. All that studying is apparently paying off.
: Point is, I ain’t pretendin’ to be no Guy Fieri or anythin’, but I can cook some basic stuff. I just normally ain’t allowed to use fire at Makoto’s place, so I have to resort to other methods.
: So...you microwave things?
: Cookin’s still cookin’, ain’t it?
: I mean...you’re not wrong-
scene mikusecretapt10
: Then leave it to me.
: I’ll whip ya up a grade-A meal with whatever you’ve got in the fridge! Unless it’s some sorta body. I ain’t gonna endorse you breakin’ any laws, you hear me?
: I mean...I do. But-
: Silence! The time for flavor has arrived!
scene mikusecretapt12
: What kinda house only keeps bean sprouts stocked up?
: You’d have to ask Touka. I don’t stay here long enough to warrant keeping any food here at all.
scene mikusecretapt13
: Does she live here too? That her condition for lettin’ you have the place for free? Blink twice if you’ve become the rich girl’s slave.
: It’s not like that. She just hangs out here when she wants to...hang out here, I guess?
: You bone her yet? See her boobs up close? They as crazy as they look while she’s wearin’ clothes?
: I have not boned her. But she did jerk me off in an alley once.
: Nice. It’s always the classy ones who are into that kinky stuff.
scene mikusecretapt14
: You know, ignoring the fact that it’s just bean sprouts, this really doesn’t look that bad.
: Hard to mess up bean sprouts. Sorry that’s all I could do for ya.
: I’ve actually been practicin’ cooking a lot lately since nobody at the Miyamura’s place can do it and Maki ain’t really been in the mood to try.
scene mikusecretapt15
: Yeah, well...she did basically find out I’ve been having sex with both of her daughters behind her back. That’s probably going to fuck her up for a little while.

: It’s kinda weird seein’ her so...uptight, I guess. Like, tryin’ to give us curfews and makin’ sure we don’t work too long at the shop anymore. Feels like she’d just fire us entirely if she didn’t need the help.
: I guess that’s what you meant by “new” Maki, then?
: She’s still Maki. But yeah...she’s been kinda different lately. Sad. Like she doesn’t really get it, you know?
: I mean...she does get it. That’s the problem. She’s not like everyone else who will sit idly by while I fuck the entire city — teenagers included.
: Yeah, but it’s like I said before. Society’s all about doin’ what everybody else is doin’. And if Maki’s the only person who’s got a problem with it, don’t that make her the abnormal one?
: There are other people with problems. You’re just not exposed to them as often as I am.
: But you literally just said she’s not like everyone else who will sit idly by while you bang the entire city. Ain’t that a critical hippo?
scene mikusecretapt16
: Excuse me?
: Way I look at it’s kinda simple, Sensei. You might look like an adult. You might have lived as long as an adult. Heck, you basically just are an adult.
: I...am an adult.
: You’re kinda not, though. Like, even when you were teaching, you always felt more like a friend my age than any of the other old people I’ve met.
scene mikusecretapt17
: Probably why I like you so much. I ain’t ever felt that way about adults before. Or anybody, really. But you know what I mean, yeah.
: I do...And it shows that I’ve been...unintentionally successful as a coach in mental gymnastics since that’s exactly what any girl who has been groomed would likely say.
: Maybe you’ve just gotta teach Maki those same gymnastics then?
: Like, I know I probably ain’t smart enough to figure out what’s right and wrong about all of this when it comes to actual morals or whatever.
: But I know that bein’ with you makes me happy. And I know that bein’ with me makes you happy. And that if we can’t make each other happy because of a number...that’s kinda lame, ain’t it?
: So many bean sprouts.
scene mikusecretapt18
: You just dodgin’ questions now?
: Well, yeah. I don’t want to be complicit or agree with any of what you’re saying because that sends the wrong message.
: What’s the right message then? Give it to me in a way some girl with a D- average could understand.
: Some things are just black and white. This is one of them.
: So the message is to just accept and deal with the rules we’re handed without questionin’ ‘em? And that Maki’s slump is actually a good thing because she’s goin’ by the book?
: Cause, if that’s the case, Makoto’s the bookiest girl I know and she doesn’t have a problem sleepin’ with ya. Since when does Maki know more than Makoto about literally anything?
scene mikusecretapt19
: You know you agree with me, Sensei. That’s why ya keep doin’ the things you’re doin’.
: That’s precisely not why I keep doing the things I’m doing, Miku. I do this because I’m addicted, selfish, careless, and self-destructive. It’s the worst combination possible.

: But I don’t think I can change at all in a place like this. How could I when people like you can sit here and try justifying my actions for me when they are specifically designed to be unjustifiable?
: We’re startin’ to get into the “too many big words for Miku” zone but, let me just say this.
: You’re one of the very few things out there I’m not afraid of, Sensei. And that’s gotta count for somethin’.
scene mikusecretapt20
: So the question now is what we do about Maki. ‘Cause it ain’t like me and- ahem. It ain’t like Makoto and I are gonna just quit spreadin’ our legs for ya cause it made our mom all sad, you know?
: You’ll just let her keep feeling insane on her own, then?
: In a world where everybody’s crazy, it’s the normal person who’s insane, I think. So there ain’t much you can really do but just...wait for ‘em to cave, I guess.
: I’m sorry. I’m talkin’ too much. All this Maki stuff’s just been really messing with the vibes for Makoto and I. Like, we ain’t sure if we should be doin’ anything or what.
: Do you really feel safe with me, Miku?
scene mikusecretapt21
: You really think I’d come all the way over to some secret apartment by myself if I didn’t?
: Sensei, if you wanted to hurt me, you’d have done it already.
: Mentally, I mean. Physically, you did kinda destroy my vagina.
: But hey, somebody was gonna one day. And I’m glad that person was you — even if your morals and some rulebook would have me think otherwise.
: You and Makoto are both way too good at justifying this. Her, I get. But at least she had the ethical dilemma of questioning the entire concept of one’s age in an infinite world when-
: And I’m glad that person was you — even if your morals and some rulebook would have me think otherwise.
: Sensei?
scene mikusecretapt22
: Itadakimasu...
scene black
Miku and I eat our “dinner” together and, to my surprise, the taste isn’t all that bad.
I kind of expected her to forgo seasoning entirely, but...given what she had to work with, I’m definitely impressed.
I guess it is kind of hard to mess up bean sprouts, though. And that there are some things in life that you need to go out of your way to destroy if you really want to complain about them.
I think I do that a lot. And it makes me thankful to have someone like her here to prove to me just how futile that can be when faced with a foil.
I just wish the circumstances were different. But even if they were, I’m sure I’d find something else to taint the flavor of life. Another ethical dilemma to bring up at the dinner table.
And one more thing to ponder while staring at the ceiling in the hours before I manage to fall asleep.
